items.title: The Day Mirror 1 Arrived!
items.caption:
I definitely never planned to spend the next nine months learning things I’d never even heard of.

I just couldn’t settle for “good enough.”

One idea became another.

Then another.

Then another.

Until one day…

Instapic existed.

Today, exactly nine months later…

I’m proud.

Not because it’s finished…

(it probably never will be!)

But because an idea scribbled on a piece of paper somehow became something real.

Something that didn’t exist before.

And something that’s unmistakably me.

❤️ Lorie x
items.alt: Gemma and I posing together in front of our first Magic Mirror on the day it arrived.
